The streamlined telescopic arm effortlessly extends from 4 inches to 6.75 inches and pivots on a 260* arch. An anti-slip silicone finish offers added support and a gentle, scratch-free connection. Adjust the mount to find your perfect viewing angle thanks to a rotating ball joint that tilts and pivots between landscape and portrait mode for ultimate flexibility.
